name: Bellahalli
tagline: Where northern neighbourhood roads meet new home choices.
description: Bellahalli sits within the wider Thanisandra–Kogilu–Kannur residential belt. Its local road connections and the regional education anchor of REVA University at Kattigenahalli help place it in the northern-city context. Projects may use Thanisandra in marketing while naming Bellahalli in the actual address.
